name: Argelys Samuel Oriach
description: I am a performance artist, creative technologist, and multi-hyphenate director operating across writing, visual art, music, theatre, television, retail, fashion, film, and macro-systems architecture. Having reverse-engineered my existence out of systemic poverty in the Dominican Republic, I design digital and organizational infrastructure through my central deployment: the Universe API—a macro-systems framework grounded in first-principles logic and sovereign autonomy. My first medium is the body: I architect physical transformation as a design system, whether on stage, screen, or in the market. Founder and Principal Architect of Seven Eighty Three and author of This Is Not a Love Story (Yankees). Currently writing the autofiction novel Graduation. Based in New York City and available for Creative Director, Head of Creative, and Systems Architecture roles across luxury fashion, cultural institutions, and non-tech retail.

birthPlace.name: Santiago de los Caballeros, Dominican Republic
